performance_changes: Restrict sliding-layer work to original-position window ranges while retaining batch isolation and padding holes.
Batch one Metal encoder layer per owned frame; expire transient slots only after completion or cancellation.
Allow skipping the GLiNER tokenizer tree for verified EmbeddingGemma 2 manifests without wrapper markers or Unicode escapes; retain file reads, identity validation and wrapper fallback.

serving_diagnostic.note: Four CPU query requests with opt-in tracing, after the first benchmark campaign and before the extraction OOM stage fix. Warm manifest resolution remains about 86-88 ms. The official tokenizer vocabulary includes a Unicode escape and therefore takes the conservative GLiNER scan fallback; the conditional fast path did not eliminate this cost for the pinned checkpoint.

The remaining GLiNER preflight response/metric stage regression was fixed and passes in the final focused Debug run. This is not a whole-package final Debug qualification.

production_hardening: Model-config allocation failures in the EmbeddingGemma2 extraction family probe retain the model-stage HTTP error and metric classification; existing GLiNER denial/recovery regression passes.
Mac CLI compiler memory estimate raised to 14 GiB after observed roughly 13 GiB ReleaseFast compilation; final build log confirms the declared estimate admits the build.
remaining_gates: Native latency and throughput targets for the intended deployment remain unspecified. This compact campaign measures observed local latency, not an SLO pass.
No labeled application dataset was evaluated; routing correctness here is numerical agreement with PyTorch, not measured application accuracy or calibrated coverage.
Clean-host concurrency and longer operating-duration resource qualification remain outside this compact check.
